topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the framing and introductory remarks for the lecture.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central role of C3 in complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the core architecture of the complement cascade, its naming conventions, and the pivotal biochemical role of C3.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream recognition pathways that drive complement activation and surface deposition.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream immune processes through which activated complement destroys pathogens and clears infection.

topics.label: Regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the regulatory factors and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct pathological conditions and infection risks associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the molecular strategies pathogens deploy to overcome complement attacks, along with their clinical and laboratory applications.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and previews the next lecture in the series.
